initial.title: [v0.92.1][Runtime] Add New Polis citizen Welcome Package for resident agents
initial.goal: Write one versioned, agent-readable Welcome Package that helps newly admitted residents understand Axioma Polis and its governed boundaries.
initial.required_outcome: A concise source-grounded Welcome Package explains Polis context, resident identity, the Shepherd help path, Layer 8 communication, conditional agent-to-agent actions, forbidden actions, privacy, credentials, and safe escalation without claiming new Runtime behavior.
authority_boundary: The document describes current governed behavior and grants no authority
Runtime admission, communication eligibility, Layer 8 authority, and provider availability remain authoritative
Documentation cannot prove live delivery to an agent or implement onboarding automation
operator_constraints: Never write tracked work on main
Use a bound FastWork issue worktree for the document
Do not modify or restart the live Runtime
Do not change Rust, APIs, OpenAPI, Observatory, providers, configuration, or cloud resources
initial.task_boundary: Author the single Welcome Package document and its lightweight documentation contract only.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: The document is explicitly versioned and addresses a newly admitted model-backed resident agent
AC-2: It explains Axioma Polis, resident identity, other residents, the Polis Shepherd, and Layer 8 in plain language
AC-3: It describes agent-to-agent communication only as conditional on Runtime admission, communication eligibility, Layer 8 authority, and provider availability
AC-4: It forbids unrestricted autonomous messaging, credential access, external side effects, unbounded loops, private-data disclosure, and invented capabilities
AC-5: It directs the resident to ask the Shepherd or operator, request a governed action, clarify uncertainty, or decline when policy is missing
AC-6: Its tone is welcoming and supportive without lore, personhood claims, or capability fantasy
AC-7: Lightweight offline documentation checks and exact-head independent review pass
dependencies: Current Runtime resident-agent, Shepherd, Layer 8, and governed A2A contracts are read-only source evidence
non_goals: No Runtime implementation or delivery mechanism
No Rust, API, OpenAPI, Observatory, provider, configuration, or cloud change
No live model or Runtime validation
initial.plan_summary: Draft one source-grounded versioned Welcome Package, validate its required sections and safety language offline, obtain exact-head documentation review, and publish without merging.

steps.action: Draft the versioned Welcome Package from current resident-agent, Shepherd, Layer 8, and governed communication source evidence.
Run the issue-owned documentation validator and Markdown/diff hygiene checks.
Obtain independent exact-head documentation review and publish the PR without merging.

invariants: Documentation claims only current governed capabilities
No credentials, private state, or machine-local paths appear
No live Runtime or provider proof is implied
risks: Friendly language could overstate capability or personhood
Static documentation could drift from Runtime policy
Readers could mistake future onboarding automation for delivered behavior
stop_conditions: A claim cannot be grounded in current repository evidence
The document would imply new Runtime behavior
Scope expands beyond the one document and validator

validation_lanes.proof_role: Check that the versioned document exists; contains required orientation, governance, safety, help, welcome, and support markers; and excludes specified secret, host-path, lore, personhood, and capability-fantasy markers. Exact-head review confirms qualitative tone in context.
Reject malformed whitespace and patch artifacts.

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on unsupported capability claims, missing governance conditions, secret or host-path content, missing required sections, or scope beyond documentation.
review_prompts: Is every capability statement grounded and conditional on current Runtime gates?
Does the package clearly state forbidden actions and help paths?
Is the tone supportive without personhood or capability fantasy?
Is this strictly one documentation artifact plus its lightweight validator?
initial.review_scope: The Welcome Package document, source-grounding, tone, governance boundaries, and lightweight docs validation only.
